text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki delivered a strong performance 
at the Asahi Hai FS. Expectations for her 
to become a "Triple Crown Umamusume" 
continue to mount.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reporters eagerly swarmed her for an 
impromptu interview. However, Fuji Kiseki 
handled them smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next, she wants to experience a grand 
stage ahead of the "Satsuki Sho." To 
answer Fuji Kiseki's wishes, the goal was 
set on the "Yayoi Sho."
